paper_title: Basic Operational Preorders for Algebraic Effects in General, and for Combined Probability and Nondeterminism in Particular
statement: The main limitation we see of the present paper is the restriction throughout to admissible basic operational preorders. The admissibility condition plays a fundamental role in almost everything we do. It is, however, violated by some natural operational preorders; for example, for countable demonic nondeterminism. It is an open question how to incorporate such more general preorders into our theory.
